data.name: Toxin Resistance
data.description: A toxic talon's constant exposure to varied poisons grants him increasing resistance to them. A toxic talon gains a +%1 bonus on saving throws against diseases and poisons, and he gains a +1 bonus on Heal checks to treat diseases and poisons. He also gains a +%1 bonus on caster level checks (including when he activates a magic item) to treat or remove poisons and diseases, such as when using remove disease or neutralize poison. Finally, he gains a +%1 bonus on Perception checks to identify traps that utilize diseases or poisons.|RogueLVL/3
